entities.summary: El Tigre is a city in Anzoategui, Venezuela. Located in what is called the "Guanipa Mesa", a river (Tigre) runs across the city. The average temperature is 79 °F, all year around, and the annual average rainfall is 1,200mm. One nearby tourist destination is the Chimire Cliffs.
